name: DaoCloud
note: Container platform vendor. Broad upstream coverage; upstream whitelists are adjusted without notice.

name: 1ms.run
note: Commercial acceleration service with a free public tier. Layers answer quickly, but transfers are far slower than the other mirrors here and swing by an order of magnitude: measured from one egress (2026-09-22), a full `docker pull` of alpine finished in 28s while the same 3.8 MB layer fetched directly took 269s. Usable, but not where a pull wants to land.

name: hub.rat.dev
note: Little public information about the operator. It answers by redirecting to docker.1ms.run, so it behaves like that mirror and stands or falls with it — currently the slowest of them: a pull took 68s from one egress (2026-09-22), and a direct fetch of the same 3.8 MB layer stalled at 2.2 MB and never finished. Listed because people use it, not because it is recommended.
